headline: Equatorial Guinea inflation rises to 3.5%, passing CEMAC regional target
summary: Equatorial Guinea's annual inflation rate reached 3.5% in October, exceeding the Central African Economic and Monetary Community's 3.0% regional threshold.
why: Equatorial Guinea is a member of the CEMAC monetary union utilizing the Central African CFA franc.

impacts.name: Equatorial Guinea
impacts.why: Higher consumer price growth reduces household purchasing power across consumer categories.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
